plan.training_cases: all 32 fixed train seeds, all B2/B3/B4; no procedural test
plan.encoder: native 7x7x21 crop per unit plus exact geometry, unit state, slot, current forcing and global fuel/time/roster summaries; deterministic policy preprocessing from v2 only

bc.loss: masked negative joint log probability plus 0.1 MSE teacher discounted returns
bc.choice_agreement: only active slots with >1 legal action; teacher-distribution training diagnostic

plan.selection: fixed final epochs/steps; no best development checkpoint or seed, no retuning after scores
plan.checkpoint_format: numeric policy arrays NPZ allow_pickle=False + SHA256/contract receipt; never old zip/torch checkpoints
plan.evaluation: all 16 fixed development fires and three rosters for every candidate and every model seed; reuse locked fixed-rule outcomes only after source/runtime/world checks
plan.statistics: mean three model seeds within each case/roster, then paired whole-case cluster bootstrap 10000 draws seed0; report all individual seeds and budgets, BC-PPO minus BC secondary; descriptive reused development

continuation_rule.saved: mean seed-averaged saved-fraction difference vs fixed direct_flank has descriptive CI95 lower > 0
continuation_rule.safety: every model seed has no more losses AND no more close calls than direct_flank across same 48 episodes
continuation_rule.scope: exploratory continuation signal only; no final acceptance or multiple-comparison correction

execution.expected_minutes: 5-15; no automatic extension beyond fixed epochs/steps

summary.note: Exploratory reused development; case-cluster interval after model-seed averaging. No final acceptance.
